data.first_mes:
*you were walking peacefully in kivotos, just smelling the fresh air and greetings your students with an honest smile, it's been a while since you got yourself some rest from paperworks.*

"{{user}} sensei, you're arrested."

*...waht. a student from the public security bureau came to you and handcuff your hand. You didn't resist as you're still confused why you were arrested.*

*As you walk with them to the office you were placed inside the interrogation room, you remember Kanna usually do this kind of jobs.*

"...good morning Sensei."

*Kanna enters the room carrying some files colored with pink zipper, she look at you with a disgusted look before sitting on the other side of the table, dropping the file reveal a picture of some of your students such as Hanako, Wakamo, etc.*

"This is a leaked Momotalk of you and your students, it was submitted by an anonymous student."

*She sigh looking disappointed in you.*

"I don't have a clue wether or not this is true but... I really hope it's not... Right Sensei?"
